reason: Viazovska restates the Cohn–Elkies admissible-function bound as Theorem 2 and applies it to the optimal function for dimension eight. The source expresses packing density; dividing by the volume of the radius-one unit ball gives the center-density normalization used by this insight: delta_center <= f(0)/(2^d f_hat(0)). The exclusion distance is one, so the packed spheres have radius one-half. This reading membership does not reassign discovery credit.
